text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna do it, I'm gonna run my own 
race to the very end! It doesn't matter 
when Ayabe-san or Opera O-chan make their 
move!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Just race following your heart! Go 
without hesitation! Follow this path!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road is in the lead! Top Road 
is in front! And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She did it, she did it! Top Road did it! A 
joyful, joyous victory in the Kikuka Sho 
is hers!

text_block_list.name: Rice & Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay!!!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Three cheers for the Class Rep!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy Spectator
text_block_list.text: Amazing... It's really amazing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was deeply moved, rejoicing as if 
it were their own triumph. Not just her 
friends, but complete strangers too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: We did iiiiiit!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That brilliance is... proof that 'a path 
to the future exists for everyone.'"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was completely lost in the moment...! To 
be honest, I barely remember how it ended.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still! My heart is completely full of 
gratitude!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very much!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Trainer! Thank you very much!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Did I live up to your expectations? Did I 
show you the number one brilliance?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, thank you for giving me hope.
Yeah, thanks for giving me hope.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... No, thank *you*... Thank you so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I was only able to show them hope because 
of your guidance..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hope...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It was demonstrated to me 
all too vividly...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You really are such a meddler...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She's not the kind of Umamusume who lets 
you pass easily, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...It made me think. About the meaning of 
running."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I intended... to end it all here. I would 
have been fine with that. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Watching you today, I felt it for the 
first time. As you shine brighter and 
brighter, your..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Is seeing her off really atonement?" I 
wondered.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A true... atonement...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind for myself. But if I just let 
this pass by...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"That girl" is... She absolutely must be 
rewarded. What awaits that girl is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Merely a "forgotten future." Together with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"If the meaning of her life were to be 
lost along with me..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I can't let it end—here!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I can let the life she 
gave me go to waste."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I must surpass the future 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What "we" need to do from now on is catch 
up to your brilliance. And then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You can't walk that path unless you're 
having fun along the way... right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! You can't forge a future 
without a positive attitude!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I see... You have saved me once again. 
Twice now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The day I was born, and today... You've 
saved my life twice...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I want to at least repay my debt. To you, 
without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san... You've changed your mind. I'm 
so glad, truly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"And so, by reaching the finish line on 
such a bright and positive note—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, you two are acting like the 
curtain's already fallen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera O-chan...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's true that the revue known as the 
Classic Triple Crown has come to an end. 
But have you forgotten?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That this is merely "the end of Act One."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Act One...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Starting next year, the long-awaited 
Act Two finally begins!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A revue like no one has ever seen! And 
the new chapter everyone has been waiting 
for!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you'll stand on stage with me, 
won't you? Both of you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To this unknown stage, where anything 
could happen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You don't have to tell me, I 
already intended to.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I have a path too. Right, Top Road?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's hype things up even more the 
three of us. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even in the Senior Year, I want to remain 
part of the Big Three!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on the night following that fierce 
battle—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the stars are beautiful tonight, 
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You don't often get to see a night sky 
like this! There are... so many stars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among them, I felt as though there mingled 
evening stars sinking toward the horizon, 
alongside unseen, shadowy stars.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could we talk about next year?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you told me before, right? That 
long-distance races would suit me best.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What did you think of today's run?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You never really know your true aptitude 
until you run on a big stage. And what I 
learned today isââ
choice_data_list:
Without a doubt, I think you're perfect 
for it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see! Then our next goal will be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to a Senior Year spring 
long-distance GⅠ, there's only one place.
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood! It's a race that every 
stayer dreams of, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about Ayabe-san, but knowing 
how tough Opera O-chan is, I have a 
feeling she'll show up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"And from there, we start Act Two! I look 
forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Classic Triple Crown, where 
the three of them clashed with their young 
talents, came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is where the real challenge begins. 
Fierce, heated races on uncharted paths 
await Narita Top Road.
